## Bottom line
**Suggests Invasive (99%)** · Confident · Careful review
Tier-1 surgical frozen section with unanimous Invasive support [F1] and suspected superior and medial margin involvement [F7].

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | Invasive 99%, InSitu 1% (ECE 5%) | Strong Invasive call; n=132 calibration |
| Conformal set | {Invasive} at alpha 10% | Single class; 90% coverage (76%–98%) |
| Reliability / OOD | 98% reliability, OOD 1.0 (12/12 regions) [F6] | Unflagged despite JPEG-3; AUROC 70% |
| CONCH–MUSK agreement | Agree on top class | Independent foundation models concur |
| Similar cases | 5/5 Invasive (74%–84% similarity) [F5] | Unanimous; nearest InSitu at 68% |

## Tissue evidence
- **Frequent mitotic figures** (regions 1, 2, 7) · ↑ invasive · Contribution 0.91 (z=+1.31) [F2]; failed AI spot check (0/20) · Unreliable
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (regions 0, 4, 6) · ↑ invasive · Contribution 0.83 (z=+1.42) [F3]; 19/20 AI spot-check pass · Validated
- **Marked nuclear pleomorphism** (regions 2, 9, 11) · ↑ invasive · Contribution 0.72 (z=+1.55) [F4]; 18/20 AI spot-check pass · Validated
- **Gland / tubule formation** (region 4) · ↑ invasive · Contribution 0.60 (z=-1.42, caption mismatch); 18/20 AI spot-check pass · Weak

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Faithful; deleting top-3 risk regions drops P(Invasive) beyond random (+0.011, 95% CI +0.002 to +0.020, n=132).
- **Concepts**: Unproven (+0.001 vs random, 95% CI -0.009 to +0.006); leans on Unreliable mitoses (0/20), lobules (0/20), necrosis (3/20).

## Could be wrong if
- High-grade InSitu (contrast case BACH_0197, 68% similarity) mimics stromal invasion in regions 0, 4, and 6.
- Severity-3 JPEG degradation on simulated frozen section distorts morphology or margins (stains blocked; HoVer-Net disabled).

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 0, 4, 6, 7**: Confirm true stromal invasion over InSitu in top heatmap and invasion regions.
2. **Regions 0, 4, 8**: Assess superior (108 um) and medial (323 um) margins for tumor at ink.
3. **Regions 1, 2, 7, 9, 11**: Verify nuclear pleomorphism and count mitoses directly, ignoring Unreliable mitoses scoring.
